notes: Paper constrains ALP-gluon coupling C_G/f_a (GeV^-1) vs ALP mass, spanning ~1e-20 to ~3e-12 eV. This is the axion-gluon coupling that induces an oscillating nuclear Schiff moment / theta parameter, NOT directly a neutron EDM d_n in e*cm. The y-axis of Fig. 4 is C_G/f_a in GeV^-1.
